title: Evaluation of bounded unfolding
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean directed acyclic circuit whose gates have pairwise distinct input vertices and whose NOT gates each have exactly one input, and let $x$ be an assignment of Boolean values to its $n$ input variables. For every natural number $f$, vertex index $v$, and polarity $p$, if $v<n+	ext{number of gates of }C$ and $v<f$, then unfolding $v$ with fuel $f$ and polarity $p$ evaluates to the value of vertex $v$ under $x$ when $p$ is true, and to its negation when $p$ is false.
